terms.definition: Inspect, modify, commit, publish, and live-external actions are separate authorization phases for the current logical task. A completed, redirected, ambiguous, discussion-only, or analysis-only request does not authorize a later state-changing phase.

Use the target-registered canonical owner for a fact type, preserve its conflict resolver and synchronization direction, and treat routing records, summaries, evidence, frequency, and recency as non-authoritative unless that owner says otherwise.

A change that crosses a target-recorded protected category requires a current scoped approval whose semantic and path surfaces cover the actual change; changing the plan or scope invalidates approval as defined by the target policy.

Name changed semantic facts, re-derive their invariants, identify canonical owners and directly dependent surfaces, reconcile related findings as one repair set, validate the result, and report unresolved relationships and residual risk.

Start from the smallest matching profile and selected index branch. Expand only for an applicable owner, safety or approval boundary, named dependency, changed-fact relationship, conflict, failed validation, or explicit broader audit, and record why the expansion occurred.

semantic_preload.fallback: load the referenced canonical owner and do not infer a missing stale conflicting cyclic or unsupported compact term
